secret: The Count de Morcerf is Fernand Mondego, the Catalan fisherman who posted the denunciation.
The English clerk of Thomson & French, Lord Wilmore, the Abbé of chapters 26–27 and Sinbad the Sailor are all Edmond Dantès; from chapter 34 the Count of Monte Cristo is known to be Sinbad.
The Count's Greek companion is named Haydée.
Andrea Cavalcanti is Benedetto, the foundling Bertuccio saved at Auteuil.
The 'Baroness' of Auteuil, mother of the buried child, is Madame Danglars.
Noirtier killed General de Quesnel in a duel on the night he disappeared.
Madame de Villefort is the poisoner in the Villefort house.
Valentine is alive; the Count saved her with a sleeping draught.
